recap.analyst:
Coloso Ciudad and Thames Rovers drew 2-2. On expected goals it finished 0.12–0.42: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Coloso Ciudad had 62% of the ball. Pass completion COL 85% (200/236), TRV 77% (109/141). Shots 1–3, on target 1–1.

Coloso Ciudad started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Thames Rovers in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: COL to 3-4-3 at 68' (chasing the game).

Turning point, 35': An own goal by M. Cuadrado The chance was worth xG 0.13 (about 13 in 100 go in), struck at 99 km/h. Score now COL 1-1 TRV.

By the numbers: Z. Bauer completed the most passes (36); P. Coman hit the top speed (30.1 km/h); G. Petit covered the most ground (5.78 km, a 15.9 km per-90 pace); G. Petit won the most challenges (10).

Discipline: fouls 2–10, yellows 1–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: overcast, 15°C, pitch wet, quick.
recap.fan: What a game at Estadio Coloso, Mexico City. An own goal opened the scoring in the 16th minute, and Coloso Ciudad were ahead. Then an own goal in the 35th gave Thames Rovers another. G. Petit struck in the 62nd for Thames Rovers. P. Falcão struck in the 77th for Coloso Ciudad. Coloso Ciudad had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: G. Petit, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
